title: Flight 19: The Bermuda Triangle Disappearance
description: In December 1945, five U.S. Navy aircraft vanished during a training mission off Florida. Radio transmissions and a massive search turned the incident into one of aviation's enduring mysteries.

scenes.narration: On December 5, 1945, five Navy bombers took off from Florida for a routine training mission.
